faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Assistant (JRA).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 20 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on 1 April 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship Rs. 25,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000 per month for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: First Class in B.Pharm.; M.Pharm. (Pharmaceutical Chemistry) with first division.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian citizens who are resident of Uttar Pradesh are eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Duration of the research project is 3 years. Terms and conditions of appointment as per guidelines of CSTUP and CSJM University, Kanpur.
